Tools.OutlineHint: Click grid points to outline the dungeon. Click the first point or press Enter to finish, right-click to undo, Escape to clear.
Tools.MarkersHint: Click a cell edge to require tags or a door there, click a cell center to require a door inside the tile. Shift-click reuses the last marker, right-click removes one.

CollectionsRoot.Name: Collections root directory
CollectionsRoot.Hint: New tile collections are created as sub directories of this folder in your Foundry user data.

WallSnapDivisions.Name: Wall editor snap divisions
WallSnapDivisions.Hint: How many segments each tile side is divided into when drawing walls in the tile editor.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Write detailed troubleshooting messages to the browser console (F12).

CollectionsMenu.Name: Tile collections
CollectionsMenu.Label: Manage collections
CollectionsMenu.Hint: Create tile collections, register existing directories and edit tile tags and walls.

Collections.Title: WFC tile collections
Collections.Hint: A collection is a directory with tile images and a mapping.json that stores the side tags and walls for each tile. Tiles may be added to or removed from a collection at any time.
Collections.Empty: No collections registered yet. Create one or add an existing directory.

Editor.Title: Collection
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.BoundaryHint: Suggested tags for tile sides that face the outline, e.g. "wall". Used to pre-fill the generate dialog.
Editor.RestrictedHint: Pre-fills "Only where marked" in the generate dialog, e.g. "door".
Editor.NoMappingYet: This directory has no mapping.json yet. It is written when you save.
Editor.AddTileHint: Images must be inside the collection directory. Use the file picker's upload button to copy images into it. "Scan directory" adds every unmapped image with empty tags.
Editor.ScanAdded: Added {count} new tiles. Edit them to set tags and walls.
Editor.ScanNone: Every image in the directory is already mapped.
Editor.DeleteConfirm: Remove {file} from the mapping? The image file is kept.
Editor.NoTiles: No tiles yet. Add a tile or scan the directory.
Editor.OutsideDirectory: Tiles must be stored inside the collection directory {dir}.

Tile.Title: Tile
Tile.TagsHint: Comma separated tags per side. Two tiles may touch only when the tag sets on the shared side are identical. Use * to match anything.
Tile.WeightHint: Relative probability of this tile being chosen.
Tile.RotateHint: Also use this tile rotated by 90, 180 and 270 degrees. Tags and walls rotate with it.
Tile.WallsHint: Click two snap points to add a wall segment. Hold Shift to chain segments. Right-click a wall to remove it.

Markers.TagsHint: Both tiles touching this edge must have exactly these tags on that side. Leave empty to only require features.
Markers.FeaturesHint: door or secret: at least one of the two tiles must draw that kind of door on this edge.
Markers.CellFeaturesHint: door or secret: the tile placed here must draw that kind of door inside the tile.
Markers.EmptyHint: Leave everything empty to remove the marker.

Generate.Title: Generate dungeon
Generate.RestrictedHint: Tags and door features that may only appear where a marker asks for them, e.g. door. Leave empty to let the generator place them freely.
Generate.MatchSurroundingsHint: Previously generated tiles next to the outline constrain the new tiles, and no outline wall is placed between them.
Generate.NoCollections: No tile collections with tiles are registered. Open the collections menu to add some.
Generate.BoundaryHint: Tile sides that face outside the outline must match these tags. Leave empty for no constraint.
Generate.ClearExisting: Replace previous generation in this area
Generate.ClearExistingHint: Removes tiles and walls created by this module that lie inside the outline before placing the new ones.
Generate.NoCells: The outline does not contain any grid cells.
Generate.NoTiles: The selected collections contain no tiles.
Generate.Failed: No valid tile arrangement found after {attempts} attempts (stuck at grid cell {cell}). Add more tiles, relax tags or try another seed.

Clear.Title: Remove generated dungeon
Clear.Content: Remove tiles and walls placed by this module on the current scene.
Clear.MarkersDone: Removed all markers from the scene.

Errors.SquareGrid: The WFC generator requires a scene with a square grid.
Errors.NoDrawing: Select one or more rectangle, polygon or ellipse drawings first.
Errors.NeedThreePoints: An outline needs at least three points.
Errors.LoadFailed: Could not read the collection directory: {message}
